title: JANUS Engine — Howl's Moving Castle RUN-007 measured-parasitic replacement audit
scope_boundary: RUN-007 replaces RUN-006 assumptions only where a published measurement, hardware rating, or already measured JANUS datum exists. Unknown subsystem watts remain UNKNOWN rather than being filled by invented values. This is not a physical JANUS hardware run.

direct_artificial_gill_paper.important_power_boundary: The paper states that the internal and external electronic circuits were powered by an external power supply. Therefore the paper does not provide a closed self-powered fan/controller parasitic measurement for JANUS to import.
direct_artificial_gill_paper.thermal_boundary: The paper proposed a passive heat exchanger for humidity control but did not integrate it in the prototype. No active thermal-management watt value is therefore imported.

H12_hardware_rating.model: Horizon H-12 / FCS-B12 PEM fuel-cell system used by the paper
H12_hardware_rating.boundary: 40% is a manufacturer/system rating at full power, not a measured JANUS low-pO2 operating efficiency. Voltage values alone do not determine blower or valve watts because current/duty were not provided.

PEMFC_conversion.decision: No battery-neutral hardware claim may use 55% as the sole conversion assumption.

POMS_flux.ratio_target_to_measured_prototype_range: approximately 2.4x to 8.1x depending endpoints; expected flow-distribution gains remain an experimental hypothesis

thermal_management.architecture_preference: passive water-coupled heat exchanger/demister where possible
thermal_management.direct_active_electric_W: may approach zero only if passive design is validated

measured_parasitic_sum.formula: P_aux_measured = P_water + P_gas + P_AFPM_support + P_purge_average + P_crystal_trap_increment + P_controls + P_active_thermal + P_other_measured
measured_parasitic_sum.reason: The dominant required subsystem powers have not yet been measured on the JANUS article. A numeric total here would be fabricated.
measured_parasitic_sum.RUN006_12_10_8W_schedule: RETIRED_AS_EVIDENCE; retained only as a comparison envelope until each component is replaced

H12_40pct_shadow_screen_using_old_RUN006.purpose: Diagnostic only: show how replacing the optimistic 55% conversion reference with the H-12 40% full-power rating changes the previous 12/10/8 W envelope. This does NOT satisfy the measured-parasitic objective because those auxiliary watts remain placeholders.
H12_40pct_shadow_screen_using_old_RUN006.method: Scale the RUN006 55%-conversion gross-power branch by 40/55, retain 0.5 h at 12 W, 4 h linear ramp at 10 W, 1.5 h at 8 W, and retain 95% bidirectional DC/DC efficiency.
H12_40pct_shadow_screen_using_old_RUN006.interpretation: The nominal 0.130 mg/m2/s point remains energetically interesting even after demoting 55% to a 40% rated-efficiency reference, but this cannot be called a measured net-power pass until the auxiliary ledger is physically metered.

what_changed: 55% is no longer the primary pass anchor; it is sensitivity-only.
The closest measured low-pO2 prototype branch remains conservative evidence.
A 40% H-12 full-power system rating is added as an intermediate hardware reference.
Water and gas flow anchors are separated from pump/fan power; flow is not treated as watts.
Unknown AFPM, purge, crystal-trap/wiper, controls and thermal parasitics remain explicitly open.
RUN007_verdict.reason: The experiment has now reached the point where additional numerical polishing cannot replace physical subsystem metering.
